Measuring chocolate chips

A cup of standard semisweet chocolate chips weighs about 170 g, which is why a 12 oz bag holds roughly 2 cups. Mini chips pack more tightly and weigh a little more per cup; chunks and wafers have more air between them and weigh less, sometimes closer to 150 g.

Chocolate is one of the few ingredients where a cup measurement is usually close enough, because a few grams more or less only changes how chocolatey each bite is. Weighing still helps when you're swapping chips for a chopped bar: weigh the bar to match the chips, since chopped chocolate fills a cup unevenly.

Source: King Arthur Baking ingredient weight chart (170 g per cup).

Questions

How many grams is ½ cup of chocolate chips?

½ cup of chocolate chips weighs about 85 g (3 oz). A full cup is 170 g.

How many cups is 100 grams of chocolate chips?

100 g of chocolate chips is about ⅝ cup, based on 170 g per cup.

How many cups of chocolate chips are in a 12 oz bag?

About 2 cups. A 12 oz bag holds 340 g, and a cup of standard chocolate chips weighs about 170 g.
